verdict.rationale: Base44's core experience is delegating work to a built-in AI. The editor AI takes natural-language requests and updates code, styles and components, and previews design options before applying them. Superagents connect to tools, run workflows, take meeting notes and complete web tasks, and a testing agent runs browser tests. Hands-on community reports confirm the in-product AI builds working apps from a few prompts, though one user notes token-based billing can get expensive when the AI struggles. Missing for 10: independent corroboration of the Superagent and testing-agent delegation, and documentation of task-oversight and approval controls beyond design previews.
